critical_code_review_comments: ProfileCardEditor.jsx L167: `grid grid-cols-5 gap-2` is hard-coded for ALL web breakpoints. Spec says 'WEB 5 in one row; mobile stays 3x2'. At narrow phone-web widths (<400px CSS) five 3:2 tiles collapse to ~65px wide which is below the 44px touch target floor only in height (~43px). Consider `grid grid-cols-3 sm:grid-cols-5` so narrow web viewports fall back to a 3x2 like the mobile app does — this also matches the request language ('mobile stays 3x2').

HandleProfile.jsx L150-155: when cover_url is empty but photos exist, the gallery grid is painted on top of the hero region in a `grid grid-cols-3` block — this can collide with the ImageLightbox trigger geometry and makes testing fragile. Suggest promoting the first gallery photo to a visible 'hero' tile that itself routes to lightbox, instead of overlapping two layout branches.

ImageLightbox.jsx L18-35: onKey handler calls `go` and `onClose` which depend on the latest `index`/`count`. The effect's dep array includes `go` (memoized by [index,count,onIndexChange]) so it will re-register on every arrow press — fine but slightly wasteful. Not a bug.

rca of the issue: Public-page lightbox open on CP with 0 cover + 1 photo was inconclusive. Mitigation for E1: either (a) when cover_url is empty, synthesize cover from photos[0] via a lightbox-aware hero (and skip the overlay gallery) OR (b) when photos.length===1 AND cover_url is empty, render a single wide tile instead of a 3-col overlay.
